To plot the given function, we follow these steps:

- We take the curve $y=2(7^x).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14216573/assets/088e67a4b4d49a0e26d01f473e1513bce26c146da4173ada9d6b401f411253cd.png)

- Reflect it on the $x$-axis to give $y=-2(7^x).$ The $y$-intercept moves from $(0,2)$ to $(0,-2)$ but the horizontal asymptote stays at $y=0.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14216573/assets/48d991aa81c055a890199355e88c28a8ec178411687ebc260eec50e70718a72a.png)

- Then, vertically shift it by $1$ unit down to give $y=-2(7^x)-1.$ The point $(0,-2)$ moves to $(0,-3)$ and the horizontal asymptote moves from $y=0$ to $y=-1.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14216573/assets/7e44e7df0372c67db670abd63706c316560a226bd3f63dc8f9c0ca104342128c.png)
